### Probability Charts

The three probability charts shows that the probability that Alexander Volkanovski wins Islam Makhachev using KO/TKO is ~22%, using Submission is no more than 6%, and using Decision is ~20%.

### Technical Details

The function `get_ufc_data` exists in [`R/update_ufc_data.R`](https://github.com/benyamindsmith/fightr/blob/main/R/update_ufc_data.R).  The function reads data stored as `RData` from [`data/`](https://github.com/benyamindsmith/fightr/tree/main/data).  These files get downloaded and cleaned via a set of `Shell`, `R` and `Python` scripts stored in [`scripts/`](https://github.com/benyamindsmith/fightr/tree/main/scripts).  These scripts are executed periodically using GitHub workflow actions as specified in the `yml` files in [`.github/workflows/`](https://github.com/benyamindsmith/fightr/tree/main/.github/workflows).


## TidyTuesday Data

The challenge include 5 datasets.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
local_file <- "tuesdata_cached.rds"

if(file.exists(local_file)) {
    message("Found local file! Loading cached data...")
    tuesdata <- readRDS(local_file)
} else {
    message("Local file not found. Downloading from internet...")
    tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2026-07-07')
    saveRDS(tuesdata, file = local_file)
    message("Data downloaded and saved locally!")
}

tuesdata_small <- tuesdata$ufc_athletes
```
:::

library(purrr)
library(inspectdf)

iwalk(tuesdata, function(df, name) {

    df |> inspect_types() |> show_plot() |> print()
    df |> inspect_cat() |> show_plot() |> print()

})

        select(where(~ is.numeric(.) || (is.character(.) && n_distinct(.) <= 15)))

    ggpairs(df_safe) |> print()    
})
